name: Stale promotion code review
summary: Before the next campaign, the marketing or e-commerce manager gets one review of the store's discount codes: every expired, unused or duplicate code, the live and scheduled campaigns that still name each one, and a proposed action for a person to approve. It ends, deletes and changes nothing.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of e-commerce and retail work, and its own method for reviewing a store's discount codes against the campaigns that name them.
